children: Chime entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Central Service, the parent of Stride Bank, for $590 million in cash, subject to customary adjustments. All Central Service preferred shares will be redeemed immediately prior to closing. The transaction, unanimously approved by both boards, is subject to regulatory approvals, including the Federal Reserve and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. Upon completion, Chime expects to enhance its banking capabilities and become a bank holding company.
